mainEntity.name: How do I work out a daily budget for a trip?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add four lines for your destination: accommodation, food, local transport and activities. Use current prices for each, add a buffer for surprises, and you have a daily budget.

mainEntity.name: Should I include flights in my daily budget?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Flights are a one-off cost. Keep them separate, work out your daily number on its own, and add the flight cost to the total trip budget.

mainEntity.name: How big should my buffer be?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on your experience. If you know the region and your costs are mostly fixed, a small buffer is enough. On a first trip, or somewhere you can't predict prices, leave a bigger one.
